shape.description: Hollow yellow body, tapered: about one cell square at a foot band, narrowing upward, on four short block-style legs. physics.behaviour: A marble rolling in through either flank arch settles in the low bowl and waits at the front outlet, under the yellow tongue. It does not fall through the hole: the hole is narrower than the marble and acts as a seat. Pressing the raised lever tail down pivots the lever, and its toothed section drives the mechanism behind the tongue, which shoves the marble out of the front. It is a holding point as well as a launcher, and two tracks can merge into it. The launch is strong enough to climb M-10 and jump to M-11.
